prompt: Implement peak_sample(samples, width). Given a list of plain integers and a positive plain-integer width, return the earliest zero-based start index of the contiguous window of exactly width with greatest sum. Return None when width exceeds list length. Raise ValueError for invalid width or any non-plain-int sample, including bool, even if no window fits. Use O(n) time and avoid mutating input.

Implement route_name(path, routes). Return the route name for the longest matching prefix from a dict mapping string prefixes to names, or None. Inputs have absolute slash-separated paths without trailing slash except root. A prefix matches if equal or followed by a slash; root matches every absolute path. Matching is case-sensitive. Never mutate routes.

Implement allocate_quota(weights, total). Allocate a nonnegative plain-integer total among a nonempty list of positive plain-integer weights. Return a list of integer allocations in input order. Give each index floor(total*weight/sum(weights)), then assign remaining units one each by descending fractional remainder, breaking ties by smaller index. Use integer arithmetic. Raise ValueError for invalid weights or total, including bool.

Implement audit_gaps(events). Given a list of (stream, sequence) tuples with nonempty stream strings and positive plain-int sequences, return a dict mapping streams to a sorted list of inclusive missing ranges as (start,end) tuples between their observed minimum and maximum. Ignore duplicates. Omit streams with no gaps. Raise ValueError for empty/non-string stream or invalid sequence including bool. Do not enumerate all missing numbers.
